definition: This dimension controls the timing and conditions under which new abilities or skills become available to the player as they progress. Variations can include immediate access upon leveling, gradual unlocking based on experience thresholds, or specific challenges that must be completed first.
exclusion_criteria: All abilities available from the start
inclusion_criteria: Unlocks are tied to specific levels or experience points
Unlocks may require completing quests or achievements
title: Ability Unlock Schedule
